text:
Devon Park: Day 4 check-in — quick notes. TL;DR: got most local tools working, hit MFA + GHA secret access blocker, docker image fails on GPU node.

Devon Park: Yesterday I finished repo checkout, followed the devex checklist, and ran unit tests for the inference-service. All green locally (x86).

Devon Park: Blockers: 1) I can't access the internal GPU test pool (gke/gpu-qa) — my VPN says connected but kubectl to that context times out. 2) GitHub Actions secrets for my forked PR aren't available so E2E jobs fail. 3) MFA for the KMS integration keeps prompting a non-existent device when using aws-vault.

Connie (mentor): Re: GPU pool — did you add your corp cert to the VPN profile? Often the client connects but policy denies the cluster. I can check the ACLs if you share your username.

Devon Park: @Connie yep I added the cert from the onboarding page. My username is devon.park. Getting a 403 when trying to list namespaces: "Error from server (Forbidden): namespaces is forbidden"

Samir R.: For GH Actions: forks don't get secrets, that's expected. Push a branch to the main repo or ask a maintainer to trigger the job. I can run the job manually if you need a green E2E for the PR.

Devon Park: Thanks, Samir — I'll push a tiny branch to the repo. Could you run the E2E if it still needs secrets?

Samir R.: Yup. Ping me when it's pushed.

Alex T.: For AWS/MFA: try clearing aws-vault cache and re-login with the --prompt=osascript (mac) or set the device in Okta. We've seen a stale device mapping before. If that fails, escalate to sec-eng and they'll reset your MFA mapping.

Devon Park: Noted. Also the docker build for the runtime image errors on the GPU node with "cuda: driver mismatch" when I ran the quick run on qa-gpu-02. Locally the container runs fine on CPU.

Connie (mentor): That's probably the driver/kernel version mismatch. Use the recommended base image tagged in the infra README: redwood/runtime:gpu-ubuntu22.04-v2. There was a change last month. Try that tag instead of :latest.

Devon Park: Switched to the tag and retried. Build completes but when starting the container I get this log: ```runtime: failed to initialize cudnn: CUDNN_STATUS_NOT_INITIALIZED``` Any known workarounds?

infra-bot: Deploy check: gpu-image-compat (gpu-qa-02) — known issue flagged 2026-11-03. Recommendation: run with --gpus all and set NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all. See https://internal.redwood/gpu-troubleshooting.

Devon Park: Good catch infra-bot. I tried with NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all and the container started, but the inference test is 2x slower than expected. Profiling shows fallback to fp32 kernels.

Alex T.: If kernels are falling back, maybe the image lacks the cuBLAS/cuDNN libs matching the driver. Try the pinned runtime image v2-compat or reach out to eng-runtime channel. We also have a quantized dev image for testing perf.

Devon Park: Plan for today: 1) Work with Connie to confirm cluster RBAC and get list namespaces permission. 2) Push branch to main and ask Samir to run E2E. 3) Try the v2-compat image and run perf harness. 4) If MFA issue persists, open sec-eng ticket.

Connie (mentor): I'll add you to the GPU-qa rolebinding now and follow up here once applied. Expect a 5-10 minute delay.

Samir R.: Ping me with the PR link once you push. Happy to run the workflows.

Devon Park: Thanks all. Small FYI — schedule a 30m pairing with me if anyone has spare time to walk through the runtime perf harness later today. Prefer 2pm-4pm PT.

Alex T.: I can do 3pm PT. Adding a calendar invite now.

Devon Park: Appreciated. I'll update the onboarding checklist items when the RBAC and E2E are sorted. :thumbsup:

Connie (mentor): RBAC applied. Try again and let me know.

Devon Park: Confirmed: I can list namespaces now and kubectl exec into the test pod. Thanks Connie! Last step is the perf run and then I'll mark Day 4 as mostly done.

Samir R.: PR link posted in DM; starting the workflow.

infra-bot: Workflow run started: redwood/inference-e2e #452 on main (triggered by Samir R.).

Devon Park: Workflow passed! All checks green. Marking as resolved for today.

Alex T.: Nice. Welcome aboard again, Devon. Keep the updates coming, and flag anything that looks like a docs gap.

Devon Park: Will do — thanks everyone :)
